items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-25
items.q: Landry had the E-flat, tried it with him.

ctx.x: So anyway, that was the first thing I wanted to ask you about, was about change of name, you know, Zeno, and when you changed it and why. Well, when I was born, my mother had several names, Francis, Joseph, Louis, Zeno. George was nowhere around. My mother had all the children that my mother had, two before me, they died. So my grandmother said, call this one George. My mother never had in her mind to call me George. But my grandma kept calling me George until my christening time when my mother went and had me…

I'll have to make it and play music, talk more with people and I find it's a good seat. So when Natalie was playing, he was playing, I was at the... I was playing my clarinet, same keys of trouble, but he didn't. Same keys of violin. Old shops and old flats. What about George like that? I would, a lot of him, I have a picture of him taking a job. Do you have a picture of yourself? Yeah, I remember Glenn, him, Bonk, me, him, Bonk, Marsman, Riley, Jim, and Dre, Elton, Mr. Tran, we played at the Academy of Music in…
